workflow_runs.name: Libraries PR Bot
workflow_runs.display_title: MIOpen: make HIPRTC kernel includes self-contained without host STL

head_commit.message:
MIOpen: minimize HIPRTC fallback diff per maintainer review

Third-round review cleanups; no functional change:

- miopen_type_traits.hpp: restore develop's original definition order
  and spelling (integral_constant/true_type/false_type after remove_cv,
  typedef form, unwrapped is_pointer_helper, develop-style conditional),
  drop the partial-STL #error guard, shorten the header comment.
- miopen_utility.hpp: drop the partial-STL #error guard, shorten the
  header comment, restore multi-line std::forward bodies (clang-format).
- miopen_initializer_list.hpp: shorten the header comment.
- radix.hpp: drop the comment above the unchanged HIP include block.

Signed-off-by: AIwork4me <AIwork4me@users.noreply.github.com>
